ic_name: System Management Bus (SMBus 3.1) + Power Management Bus (PMBus 1.3)

spec_provided_observability.name: PMBus STATUS registers
spec_provided_observability.purpose: STATUS_BYTE / STATUS_WORD plus detailed STATUS_VOUT / STATUS_IOUT / STATUS_TEMPERATURE localize faults and warnings.

spec_provided_observability.name: SMBALERT# / Alert Response
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Out-of-band interrupt; the host enumerates alerting devices via the ARA.

spec_provided_observability.name: Telemetry read-back
spec_provided_observability.purpose: READ_VIN/VOUT/IOUT/TEMPERATURE_1 give live measurements for monitoring/debug.

spec_provided_observability.name: PEC
spec_provided_observability.purpose: CRC-8 over each transaction detects bus bit errors; mismatch is observable as a NACK.

spec_provided_observability.name: ARP / Get-UDID
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Enumerate devices and read their 128-bit UDID for identification.

spec_provided_observability.name: PMBUS_REVISION / MFR_ID / MFR_MODEL
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Identify the device's PMBus revision and manufacturer/model.

error_detection_mechanisms: Packet Error Code (CRC-8) detects transaction bit errors.
Per-byte ACK/NACK on the 9th clock detects missing/unresponsive devices.
Bus timeouts detect a hung device holding SMBCLK low.
PMBus STATUS bits (incl. CML) flag communication/command/fault conditions.
WRITE_PROTECT rejection flags illegal configuration writes.
notes: SMBus/PMBus observability is in-band: the host reads STATUS and telemetry over the same two wires, services SMBALERT# via the ARA, verifies integrity with PEC, and enumerates devices with ARP. There is no separate scan/JTAG layer in the protocol; chip-level DFT is the device implementer's concern.
